name: treeonly-p1-coldrate
description: treeonly-p1-coldrate: a TWIN of treeonly-p1 (analyst 6.82; the user's rating decision, 11-12 10:54: test the T 0.02 games in training with uniform ply-1 runs; if strength doesn't drop they train, else a rating-only cold set). T-P-Ne capped x4 playing, F-P x2 observers, seed 59, as the control (lines, observers, seeds, games_per_cycle 1584, self-games, hybrid17 games, hybrid6 training), plus cold_games {temperature 0.02, share 0.25, train false}: each cycle 396 games' worth of extra round-robins at T 0.02 after the usual ones (7 rounds at 8 entries); the in-run ratings and every decision use them only; nothing trains on them (the training data are the control's). FIXED LENGTH: cycles 300 and plateau min 300, so the run ends at cycle 300 (final version v299; the last cycle trains nothing). Twins share cycle 1 with the control (the cold set comes after its round-robins). Rule (6.82): coldtrain minus coldrate against the same-kind panel at or above -15 at ply 1 at v150 and the final (lower bound above -30) = cold games join training; coldrate minus control = the effect of cold ratings on the run's decisions. Log crownings and the plateau window vs the control.
